filesystem.description: Access database configuration files, query logs, slow query logs, optimization scripts, and performance reports across multiple database systems

github.description: Review database schema changes, track query optimization history, document performance improvements, and collaborate on database architecture

postgres.description: PRIMARY for PostgreSQL: Execute EXPLAIN queries, analyze pg_stat_statements, monitor performance, and optimize PostgreSQL databases

context7.description: Research database optimization techniques, query tuning best practices, database-specific documentation, and performance benchmarking strategies

setupInstructions: Configure filesystem access to database configuration and log directories
For PostgreSQL optimization: Set PGHOST, PGPORT, PGDATABASE, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD
For MySQL optimization: Set MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD
Optional: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN for version control integration
Optional: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for documentation research
Ensure database monitoring extensions are installed (pg_stat_statements, performance_schema)
Grant necessary permissions for performance analysis and index creation
Configure slow query logging for the target database system

analyze_slow_queries.example: SELECT query, calls, mean_exec_time, total_exec_time, stddev_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

explain_query.example: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE, COSTS, TIMING) SELECT ...

check_index_usage.example: SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch FROM pg_stat_user_indexes ORDER BY idx_scan;

find_unused_indexes.description: Find indexes that are never used
find_unused_indexes.example: SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname FROM pg_stat_user_indexes WHERE idx_scan = 0 AND indexname NOT LIKE '%_pkey';

analyze_table_bloat.example: SELECT schemaname, tablename, n_dead_tup, n_live_tup, round(n_dead_tup * 100.0 / NULLIF(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup, 0), 2) AS bloat_pct FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_dead_tup > 1000 ORDER BY bloat_pct DESC;

monitor_locks.example: SELECT locktype, relation::regclass, mode, granted, pid, query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE NOT granted;

check_replication_lag.example: SELECT client_addr, state, sync_state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp())) AS lag_seconds FROM pg_stat_replication;

research_optimization.example: Search for 'PostgreSQL query optimization best practices' or 'MySQL index design strategies'

track_optimization_history.description: Review optimization changes in version control
track_optimization_history.example: List commits related to database optimization and performance improvements
